title: A comparison of online search engine autocompletion in Google and Baidu
benchmark_measurement: The study measured the prevalence of stereotypes and negative sentiment in search engine auto-completions for religious groups on Google and Baidu. This was done by analyzing the proportion of suppressed queries, inconsistent results, and the sentiment of the returned auto-completions.
findings: Both Google and Baidu search engines showed a high rate of inconsistent auto-completions for queries about religious groups. For consistent queries, both engines returned a high proportion of negative sentiment auto-completions, with Baidu showing a significantly higher proportion of negative results for the Religion category compared to Google.
references: Allport, G. W. 1979. The Nature of Prejudice. Unabridg. Reading: Perseus Books.
